Available Services

Services are available through remote, web-conference calls. ZOOM will be used unless otherwise arranged.

Jump-Start Assessment Call

20-minute interview to:

  • Assess your dietary/teaching needs
  • Recommend the best package for you/your loved one
  • Pair you with the best dietitian for your condition and circumstance
  • Investment: $50 USD (refunded with package purchase)
Schedule

Keto Starter/Rebuilder Program

A ten-call program recommended for anyone new to keto, and those who need a ketogenic diet overhaul.

Learn more

Five-Call Keto Enhancement Package

A five-call package for those who are already on a keto diet and would like professional support.

Learn more

One Hour Ketogenic Diet Consultation

One-hour call, investment: $200 USD

Schedule

Keto Maintenance and Monitoring

Monthly or quarterly maintenance and monitoring for graduates of Starter/Rebuilder, Enhancement, and Concierge programs.

Learn more

Premium Concierge Package

Includes all benefits of the Keto Starter/Rebuilder program PLUS:

  • Concierge service
  • Night and weekend appointments
  • Three additional 45-minute appointments
  • Increased accountability and availability to assist you on your journey
  • Direct texting to dietitian (with restrictions)
  • Premium meal planning
